description: THE ADMINISTRATOR ON THE SHIPPED TABLE, AND THE TRANSFER THAT NEVER RETURNS. PROCESS-ENTER-KEY dispatching option 1 for an administrator: CDEMO-USER-TYPE 'A' arrives in the communication area with CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT already 1, so app/cbl/COMEN01C.cbl:87 takes the ELSE, line 92 receives the map, and the ordered EVALUATE EIBAID at 93-103 takes its FIRST arm, WHEN DFHENTER - gate G30. Lines 117-121 scan OPTIONI PIC X(2) (app/cpy-bms/COMEN01.CPY:132) from the right and stop at WS-IDX 2 because byte two is '1'; line 122 moves both bytes into WS-OPTION-X PIC X(02) JUST RIGHT, line 123 finds no space to INSPECT away, line 124 leaves WS-OPTION at 01 and line 125 echoes '01' into OPTIONO. The three-term guard at 127-129 is false on every term - 01 is numeric, 01 is not greater than the CDEMO-MENU-OPT-COUNT of 10 at app/cpy/COMEN02Y.cpy:21, and 01 is not zero - so no 'Please enter a valid option number...' is composed, and the ungated filter at 136-137 is decided by its FIRST conjunct alone: 88 CDEMO-USRTYP-USER (app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy:28) is false for 'A', so no 'No access - Admin Only option... ' either. Line 145 finds the flag still OFF from line 77, line 146 finds COACTVWC's leading five bytes to be 'COACT' and not 'DUMMY', and lines 147, 148 and 151 set CDEMO-FROM-TRANID to 'CM00', CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM to 'COMEN01C' and CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT back to 0 before the XCTL at 152-155 transfers WITH the communication area. Lines 149 and 150 are COMMENTED OUT, so CDEMO-USER-ID and CDEMO-USER-TYPE cross unchanged; nothing here writes CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM, which only the PF3 arm at 97 and the signon default at 173 do. WHAT MAKES THIS DISTINCT from case04 and case12: case04 walks this same first entry as a regular user, and case12 admits an administrator against a stub table whose first entry is admin-only, so both would also pass a translation that required CDEMO-MENU-OPT-USRTYPE to MATCH the caller's type; only an administrator on the SHIPPED table, whose ten authorisation columns all read 'U', refuses that reading, because a match test paints a refusal here. It is also the lower half of gate G33 - option 01 must resolve the 1-based FIRST slot of CDEMO-MENU-OPT OCCURS 12 (app/cpy/COMEN02Y.cpy:88), whose CDEMO-MENU-OPT-PGMNAME PIC X(08) at :28 is COACTVWC - while case05 pins a genuinely mid-table slot, the fifth, and the tenth and last valued slot is pinned directly by shiftingTheOccursBaseBreaksTheMenuExpectations, which requires subscript 10 to compose Bill Payment and an exclusive loop bound to leave it off the menu. THE FALL-THROUGH TRAP is the decisive assertion: an EXEC CICS XCTL never returns, so lines 157-164 do not execute and neither the MOVE DFHGREEN TO ERRMSGC at 158 nor the STRING at 159-163 happens. Were they reached, that STRING would send 'This option ' DELIMITED BY SIZE, then CDEMO-MENU-OPT-NAME(1) DELIMITED BY SPACE - which stops at the first space of the thirty-five-byte 'Account View' literal and yields the one token Account - then 'is coming soon ...' DELIMITED BY SIZE, composing the byte-exact This option Accountis coming soon ... with NO space before is. That image is asserted ABSENT: expectedMessages carries the eighty-byte WS-MESSAGE of line 38 exactly as the SPACES of line 79 left it, so a translation that fell out of the transfer into the coming-soon block fails on the message and on the colour at once. The block stays preserved dead code, neither wired up nor removed - no PGMNAME in app/cpy/COMEN02Y.cpy begins with 'DUMMY', so line 146 is always true from the shipped table - and case13 reaches it with a stub table instead. Also pinned: sends is empty and no mapset or map is named, because MAP('COMEN1A') and MAPSET('COMEN01') at 190-191 sit inside SEND-MENU-SCREEN, which a transfer never performs, and naming them would tell the client to paint the screen the program is leaving; the successor travels as a response field with the whole conversation in the payload and no server-side forward or session state - gates G40 and G37. ERRMSGC keeps the mapset's declared COLOR=RED because line 158 is unreached, and no DFHRED-plus-asterisk highlight appears in this folder at all, because COMEN01C copies no CSSETATY - its sole consumer is app/cbl/COACTUPC.cbl - so gate G38 is honoured here through the ENTER/REENTER split rather than through a highlight: this is a REENTER-side case that nonetheless emits no error output. CDEMO-USER-TYPE is trusted as it arrives and is never re-read from USRSEC, re-verified or hashed, because line 150 is commented out and the single X(01) comparison at 137 is the whole authorisation mechanism. The unit is admin.MainMenuService driven directly, with no MockMvc, no HTTP and no JobLauncher - gate G51; inputs, expectedWrites and expectedFinalState are empty because COMEN01C declares no SELECT and no FD and issues no file verb; expectedReturnCode is 0 because an online transaction sets none. Every value here is STATICALLY DERIVED from the COBOL source, the copybooks and the BMS definitions and was NEVER captured from a live COBOL execution - no such runtime exists in this environment, per the eight verified blockers recorded in 0.7.6 of the plan (risk R-A).
